## Which skill
<!-- haskell-coder, haskell-reviewer, or both -->

## What this changes
<!-- The generalized lesson / fix, in one or two sentences. -->

## Corroboration
<!-- REQUIRED for any guidance change. EITHER an authoritative citation
     (GHC User's Guide / Haskell Report / Hackage Haddock / PVP) OR a minimal module
     that compiles/runs and demonstrates it. If revising an opinion, name the tradeoff. -->

## Eval that proves it
<!-- Point to the case you added/updated in <skill>/eval-workspace/evals/evals.json.
     Describe how the CURRENT skill fails it and the edited skill passes. -->

## Checklist
- [ ] The change is generic and corroborated (citation or reproducing example) — not house style.
- [ ] Added or updated an eval that fails on the old skill and passes on the new one.
- [ ] If it revises an opinionated recommendation, the tradeoff is spelled out.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_skill.py` passes locally.
- [ ] Reference links in SKILL.md still resolve.

<!-- A maintainer will review and merge — changes are never auto-merged. -->
